name: smwmusic-erik-satie-gymnop-die-no
title: Erik Satie - Gymnopédie No. 1
description:
(My second ever try at porting an existing song.)
This is 'Gymnopédie No. 1', a famous piano piece by Erik Satie. I tried my best to make this sound as piano-like and close to the original as possible without using samples - it might still be lacking a bit, but it's nice enough to listen to at least.
Would work well for extraordinarily calm places, especially cutscenes.
